title: feat(monorepo): introduce react-based InstantSearch flavours to the codebase
body:
what i did:

* change configs (jest, babel, eslint, typescript) to be the same between packages
  * do some related linting/typing/test changes in InstantSearch.js
* choose best between custom babel plugins and test utils
* update extension-resolver babel plugin to work for local "absolute" packages
* enable e2e tests for react and react-hooks (new)
* rewrite commits with correct issue/pr links
* add script to ensure versions stay synced in React InstantSearch

what i didn't do:

* consolidate between tests/mock and tests/mocks (there's an overlap, but required too much changes in tests for now - dependencies, types, etc.)
* import from `@instantsearch/testutils` (similarly complicated babel, tests ...  changes. Can also be done later)
* fix build output of react-instantsearch pacakge (already the case before migration)
